The epitome of the South, old Oak Trees with Spanish Moss blowing in the breeze. Numerous species of birds, turtles, alligators and more call Dora Canal home. Please Note: If you are the first to book a tour, you must book at least 2 people. If you are going to book a toddler, you must book at least 1 2 Hour Boat Tour • Most Popular Cruise in Mount Dora!

quotes.text: I would highly recommend this tour. The tour left on time, the boat was clean. They also provide cold bottled water, a plus on a hot day. The captain knew his stuff and was quite the comedian. The canal was gorgeous and we saw several types of birds and a small gator. They also allow you to bring a cooler with drinks and food. An A+ in my book

This was my second time visiting Mr. Dora and my first boat ride on the lake. The boat was a mostly covered pontoon style motorboat. The day we booked, a friday, we were the only people on the 10 AM tour. There is another company that specifies that if there aren't at least 6 they don't leave the dock. Nor Rusty Anchor...

I took my mom on this tour today. She uses a cane & access was easy. Ted, our guide was great, informative, polite, professional. The pontoon boat was nice with cushioned seats, covered, blankets provided when chilly. Dora Canal was beautiful, old Florida. We had a relaxing, wonderful 2 hour tour.

This tour seems to have it all. A comfortable boat (water and ice provided) takes you along the lake where you can take in the views. It then takes you along one of the canals and out to the lake on the other side. The guide was knowledgeable and entertaining.

Very friendly and informative trip! The 2 hours went really fast and a lot of unexpected and unknown Florida history was brought up. You can also stand and move about on the boat. I definitely recommend this tour, you will be glad you did.
The boat, Captain and crew, were great! The canals are a must see! I bring all my guests to see the beauty of the water and trees. Worth doing!
